description: Opens an incident for what the checks cannot see: a slow service, a problem a customer reported. With a message it publishes the first update on the status pages that show its monitors (and emails their subscribers on Pro plans); alert pages the monitors' contacts once. It stays open until resolve_incident and never counts as downtime. Every plan, at most 20 open. Free.

alert.description: Alert the monitors' contacts once, and again when it is resolved. Ask the user first.

message.description: Optional first update for the visitors of the status pages that show the monitors.

monitor_ids.description: The monitors it affects (GET /monitors): its updates show on the published status pages that show any of them. None or up to 50.

state.description: The first update's state, investigating by default.

title.description: What the dashboard, alerts and status pages call it.

name: open_incident
title: Open an incident by hand
